question: Among all128 subsets of the seven original positive entry contacts, which are stationary-load feasible and permit forward body motion, leveling, or retreat of either rear foot without violating declared contact and floor guards?

population.selection: Only R10AP original partial step1 / semantic step513. R10AT terminal state is rationale, not the survey input. No propagated, held-out or new physical samples.
population.coverage: R10AT stalls after32 front-only steps with85mm remaining. Exhaust all original contact subsets at entry instead of tuning that stalled mode. Four named objectives test body transfer and independent rear-leg unloading; neither contact acquisition nor a full recovery is covered.

algorithm.subsets: Enumerate binary masks0..127, original positive-contact order preserved; no contact pruning, synthesized point, relaxed foot classifier or new-contact creation. Empty subset is included and must be certified by the same load solver.
algorithm.stationary_admission: For every subset use the exact R10AR capped stationary model. Retain phaseI certificates for refusals and full load allocations for feasible subsets. Only this subset supplies forces at every proposed node.
objectives: root_forward: maximize torso-origin displacement along the original torso localX axis projected into worldXZ and normalized.
torso_level: maximize worldY component of torso localY.
rear_left_retreat: maximize negative rear-left cap-center displacement along the original horizontal heading.
rear_right_retreat: maximize negative rear-right cap-center displacement along the original horizontal heading.
algorithm.objective_scope: Four independent differential objectives for every statically feasible subset. No rank across objectives, global controller selection or guarantee of decreasing the all-foot-hull gap. Report gap as a diagnostic for every tested node.
algorithm.constraints: Same R10AS coordinate bounds,0.02-rad nonworsening headroom, all original positive-marker non-descent and24 shape-witness floor guards. Every point in the chosen subset sticks; this may include zero-force points. Smaller subsets are also independently enumerated.
algorithm.finite_check: Same R10AS loaded-point projection, four nonzero fractions and11 dyadic scales. Require finite objective increase>1e-9*fraction in meters or up-dot units; original geometry guards1e-9; re-solve stationary forces using only the chosen subset. Retain all attempted scales and refusals. First passing scale per objective/subset is admitted.
algorithm.summary: Count all128 load outcomes and every feasible-subset objective. Report largest finite objective improvement per objective with lower-mask tie break solely as a diagnostic example; no native controller is selected.
algorithm.no_tuning: No changes to modes, objectives, caps, friction, headroom, bounds, thresholds or interpretations after observation.

checks: 17 inherited manufactured controls plus7 exhaustive-subset and objective-sign controls before source evaluation.
Independently replay the original entry contact packet; preserve all seven source identities.
Keep checked primal/dual certificates for static and motion LPs; retain finite proposed geometry and reallocated forces.
limitations: Stationary and discrete-node kinematic surrogate on one exposed entry input only. Support points are retained native-sampling coordinates on callback frames, with known staging and penetration limitations. Sticking subsets and marker non-descent may overconstrain real rolling/sliding. No body inertia, dynamic unload, mode transition, contact acquisition, collision-free continuous path, interbody clearance, motor commands or physical recovery are established.
